inputs.question: How many days of paid sick leave do employees get per year?

reference: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year, credited on January 1st.

inputs.question: What is the annual gym and fitness allowance?

reference: Employees are eligible for an annual gym or fitness membership reimbursement of up to INR 6,000 per year, claimable in two half-yearly installments.

inputs.question: What are the standard weekly working hours and core collaboration hours?

reference: The standard work week is 40 hours (8 hours per day, Monday through Friday). Core collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time.

inputs.question: What is the laptop hardware refresh cycle?

reference: The standard hardware refresh cycle for corporate laptops is 36 months (3 years).

inputs.question: What is the notice period for an employee during their probationary period?

reference: Employees currently undergoing their initial 90-day probationary period have a 30-calendar-day notice period.

inputs.question: How many mandatory public holidays does Acme Technologies observe in 2026?

reference: Acme Technologies observes 10 mandatory paid public holidays and provides up to 2 optional/floating holidays per calendar year.
